intro: Uruguay is often ranked the most democratic country in Latin America.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for five years and cannot serve two terms in a row. Yamandú Orsi took office in 2025. Uruguay legalised same-sex marriage in 2013 and was the first country to fully legalise cannabis.

chapters.title: José Mujica
text: Former president José Mujica became famous for his simple life, giving most of his salary away.

keyTerms.meaning: Rule by the people through elections.
